name: Final results of magnetic monopole searches with the MACRO experiment

summary.plain: MACRO found no magnetic monopoles in its cosmic-ray data. Its final limit on how many could be passing through is below the Parker bound, the astrophysical ceiling, over the whole range of speeds where grand-unified monopoles are expected.
summary.technical: Combined scintillator, streamer-tube and track-etch searches, no candidates: 90 % CL upper limit 1.4e-16 cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 on the local GUT monopole flux for 4e-5 < beta < 1, the first direct-search limit well below the Parker bound over the whole range.

title: Final results of magnetic monopole searches with the MACRO experiment
why_it_matters: As the paper states, the first direct-search limit on grand-unified magnetic monopoles that lies well below the Parker bound over the whole velocity range where they are expected.
